releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.60 — notifications and the chat list. (1) Every notification now shows the sender's picture: it used to be title-plus-text only, so a message from anyone looked identical. The picture is fetched once per conversation and fills in silently, so the alert is never delayed waiting for it. (2) Notifications are no longer messages-only: a friend request, a request being accepted, being added to a group, an incoming call while the app is closed, and a missed call each get their own alert with the right text and photo. (3) Chats tab: the unread/All/Groups/Archived pills no longer sit flush under the header — they have their own breathing room, a soft shadow and a hairline border, so they read as a control instead of part of the header. (4) The conversation header could push its search, video-call and voice-call buttons off the screen behind a long name; the title now truncates instead, so those buttons are always reachable. (5) Updates announce themselves: on the first start after a release the new-build screen opens on its own, with the full release notes scrollable and both choices — Update now, or Later. (6) NChat now asks for the battery exemption on first launch, the way other messengers do, instead of hiding it behind a Settings row — without it Android freezes the connection and messages arrive late.
